package eventually

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// retryBackoff sleeps WITHOUT a deadline condition — an ordinary retry
// loop, not an eventually loop; the matcher must stay silent.
func retryBackoff() {
	for i := range 3 {
		if ok := probe(); ok {
			return
		}

		time.Sleep(time.Duration(i+1) * 10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

func probe() bool { return true }

func TestBackoff(t *testing.T) {
	retryBackoff()
}
